tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Creates the hotel in Guest Logic in free test mode. Use only when the owner has no Guest Logic account. After it, any other tool opens the sign-in for that e-mail. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: my_hotel
tools.description: The hotel's details: name, address, phone, rooms, check-in and check-out, taxes, and whether it is in test mode. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description: The 12 setup steps: done or open, what was found for each, what needs a decision, and the reports already read. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: upload_report
tools.description: Sends one report's content as text (CSV, tab-separated or plain text, up to 4 MB) — read a PDF or spreadsheet first and send its rows. Guest Logic reads it and sets up what it can (rooms, room types, rates, taxes, stays). Returns what was found. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: submit_facts
tools.description: Rooms and stays you already extracted, as rows. Guest Logic applies them by the same rules as an uploaded report. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: confirm_facts
tools.description: Confirms or changes one setup step. step and values: hotel {name, phone, email} · taxes {state, tourism, other} as percentages · checkin {check_in, check_out} as HH:MM · policies {cancellation, deposit, noshow, pets, smoking} · room_types {CODE: {name, sleeps}} · rates {CODE: nightly rate} · rooms (

tools.name: load_stays
tools.description: Loads the stays read from the reports into the hotel. First call without confirm to see the rows that need a decision; show them to the owner; then call with confirm true. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: add_photo
tools.description: Adds a picture from a public web address (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB) to the booking page: the hotel, or one room type. 40 a day while testing. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: set_logo
tools.description: Sets the hotel's logo from a public web address (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB). Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: drop_link
tools.description: The owner's links to drop files you cannot send as text (a scanned PDF) and to manage photos. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: ask_us
tools.description: Asks the Guest Logic team to connect card payments, Expedia and Booking.com, or to finish the whole setup by hand. Connected within 24 hours. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: invite_staff
tools.description: E-mails a sign-in to a front-desk employee or a manager. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: stays
tools.description: Stays touching a date range (up to 31 days): confirmation, guest, dates, room, type, status, rate, source. Up to 200 rows a call; use page for more. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: stay
tools.description: One stay by its confirmation number. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: availability
tools.description: Rooms free each night by room type for a date range (up to 31 days). Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: house_inventory
tools.description: For one day: arrivals, departures, in house, rooms by housekeeping status, rooms out of order. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: The hotel's automations: what each sends, when, and whether it is on. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: automation_status
tools.description: The last runs of the hotel's automations: when, result, error. Needs the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: tasks_waiting_on_me
tools.description: Open tasks on the signed-in person's Home board. Needs the owner's sign-in.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: confirm_facts · Private data: drop_link · Public sink: upload_report, submit_facts, confirm_facts, drop_link · Destructive: drop_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: confirm_facts · Private data: drop_link · Public sink: upload_report, submit_facts, confirm_facts, drop_link · Destructive: drop_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

description.name: payments
description.description: Every payment and refund posted on one day, hotel time: time, method (card, cash, other), amount, the stay and guest, who posted it; totals by method. Refunds are negative. Needs the owner's sign-in.

description.name: occupancy
description.description: Per night for a date range (up to 31 days): rooms available (out of order taken off), rooms sold, occupancy %, room revenue, ADR, RevPAR (room revenue ÷ all rooms, the night audit's figure); a totals row. Needs the owner's sign-in.

description.name: rates
description.description: The nightly rate per room type and date (up to 31 days), priced exactly as the booking page prices a night, with the restrictions that close a date. Plan: the booking page's unless one is named. Needs the owner's sign-in.

description.name: morning_summary
description.description: Today in one answer: arrivals, departures, in house, rooms dirty, out of order; for a manager also money due from in-house stays, the last night audit's flags and the open escalations. Needs the owner's sign-in.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_signup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Creates the hotel in Guest Logic in free test mode. Use only when the owner has no Guest Logic account. After it, any other tool opens the sign-in for that e-mail. No sign-in needed." → after: "Creates the company in Guest Logic (a hotel in free test mode) and e-mails the owner one approval link. Use only when the owner has no Guest Logic account. The reply names everything still missing and the tool that fills each. No sign-in needed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
